parts.text: (a) Fig. 5.1 shows a plastic cup. The cup contains sand, an electric heater and a thermometer. Fig. 5.1 The power of the heater is 50 W. The mass of the sand in the cup is 550 g. The initial temperature of the sand is 20 °C. The heater is switched on for 2.0 minutes. The temperature is recorded until the temperature stops increasing. The highest temperature recorded by the thermometer is 33 °C.
